## Result Codes

| Value | SDK symbol | Kernel alias | Meaning |
| ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| -1 | `OS_ERR_NOT_READY` | `SYS_ERR_NOT_READY` | Required subsystem or state is not ready. |
| -2 | `OS_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `SYS_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT` | A scalar, flag, or semantic argument is invalid. |
| -3 | `OS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` | `SYS_ERR_NOT_FOUND` | The named object or identity does not exist. |
| -4 | `OS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` | `SYS_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL` | The supplied output capacity is insufficient. |
| -5 | `OS_ERR_IO` | `SYS_ERR_IO` | An input/output operation failed. |
| -6 | `OS_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS` | `SYS_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS` | The requested object already exists. |
| -7 | `OS_ERR_NO_RESOURCES` | `SYS_ERR_NO_RESOURCES` | A bounded object table or resource pool is exhausted. |
| -8 | `OS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` | `SYS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED` | The requested operation, version, or option is unsupported. |
| -9 | `OS_ERR_WOULD_BLOCK` | `SYS_ERR_WOULD_BLOCK` | The nonblocking operation cannot complete immediately. |
| -10 | `OS_ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` | `SYS_ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` | Kernel or process memory allocation failed. |
| -11 | `OS_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE` | `SYS_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE` | A value or geometry lies outside the supported range. |
| -12 | `OS_ERR_NO_TARGET` | `SYS_ERR_NO_TARGET` | No eligible destination exists. |
| -13 | `OS_ERR_QUEUE_FULL` | `SYS_ERR_QUEUE_FULL` | The destination queue is full. |
| -14 | `OS_ERR_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE` | `SYS_ERR_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE` | The message exceeds the bounded ABI payload. |
| -15 | `OS_ERR_PERMISSION_DENIED` | `SYS_ERR_PERMISSION_DENIED` | The caller lacks the required authority or rights. |
| -16 | `OS_ERR_BAD_BUFFER` | `SYS_ERR_BAD_BUFFER` | User memory is inaccessible for the declared direction and size. |
| -17 | `OS_ERR_TIMEOUT` | `SYS_ERR_TIMEOUT` | The bounded wait deadline expired. |
| -18 | `OS_ERR_CANCELLED` | `SYS_ERR_CANCELLED` | The operation was cancelled by lifecycle or explicit policy. |
